limitations: Full R2 and complete WindTerm 2.7.0 parity are incomplete.
Two-session fixed-size cmd slice does not establish eight-session, split, persistence, workspace restoration or dynamic resize acceptance.
No inherited IME, complete keyboard, Find, selection/copy, DPI, native on-screen rendering, physical-input or Alacritty-reference capability acceptance.
No throughput, interactive-latency, memory or WindTerm performance-equivalence claim; reported seconds are test durations.
No Linux/macOS client, daily-use release, clean-machine runtime or distributable-package acceptance.
Only synthetic assertions, selected hashes and sanitized summaries are public; raw logs/images, private paths/process IDs and complete deployment/SDK manifests remain local.
